remaining.detail: The shared GPU infrastructure and first production GPU-native dense visual layer are implemented, but the complete Three/WebGL scene is not yet migrated. Terrain presentation and Tree Fidelity still use the validated Three/WebGL2 presentation path.

The GPU-native ground-cover layer and the existing Three/WebGL2 presentation use separate canvases, so they do not share one depth buffer. A full Nexus WebGPU scene migration is required for unified depth-correct terrain, trees, player, course and effects.
CI is comfortably under the 60 second startup contract, but the exact target MacBook Air measurement still requires that physical device.
The unrelated Nexus-wide n:physics:constraints proof blocker remains outside this shared-GPU work; dedicated Host GPU and Shared GPU Compute/Render validations are green.
